title: Certificate split-word encoding
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $c$ and a Boolean word $y$, define a word by solving the split problem with parameters $C$, $c$, and the length of $y$. If the solver returns a split index $i$, encode the prefix of $y$ of length $i$ together with the suffix beginning at $i$; if it returns no index, use the empty word.
